#en: Despite common belief, we're not a charity, we do charge for our work. But, most of our funding does come from donations.
zh: 虽然大家常以为如此，但我们不是慈善机构，我们收费。不过我们大部分资金确实来自捐助。

#en: Oh? Thinking of joining up? We almost never turn down an extra set of hands, especially if you've got a strong stomach...
zh: 哦？想加入？我们几乎从不拒绝多一双手，尤其你要是心理素质过硬的话……

#en: By amplifying spatial awareness and timing, this Amp improves one's ability to position and maximise fleet effectiveness.
zh: 通过放大空间感知与时机的把握，这个增幅能提升定位能力，最大化舰队效能。

#en: You see, usually, Watchtower vessels can only be helmed by certified pilots, those with the necessary control implants...
zh: 你看，通常瞭望塔的飞船只能由认证飞行员驾驶，也就是装了必要控制植入体的人……

#en: Sometimes we'd work directly with such groups, albeit under pseudonyms and aliases. But most times, we worked indirectly.
zh: 有时我们会直接与这类组织合作，不过用的是化名和假身份。但多数时候，我们是间接合作。

#en: Hm. You do hold yourself like a local... Right stance, habit of looking over your shoulder more than you might realize...
zh: 嗯。你的举止确实像本地人……站姿对，回头看的习惯比你意识到的还多……

#en: Well... guess there's no harm in sharing. Like I told you before, grew up in Neon. Not exactly a nurturing environment...
zh: 嗯……说说也无妨。就像我告诉过你的，我在霓虹城长大。算不上什么有爱的环境……

#en: Take care down there! When I make my escape, Grav Shifting could send me anywhere, so don't count on me being close by...
zh: 下面小心！我脱身时，重力位移可能把我送到任何地方，所以别指望我在附近……

#en: While you were catching up on your beauty sleep, the Advocate handled business for us. Got the Control Node, ready to go!
zh: 你补美容觉的时候，辩护者替我们办了事。控制节点到手，随时可用！

#en: So it seems! Looks like we're stuck with each other! That is... assuming we're both not alternate versions of each other.
zh: 看来是这样！我们算是绑在一起了！前提是……我们都不是彼此的另一个版本。

#en: Considering this was my second time doing it all, I managed to do it a little bit faster -- and with a few less screwups.
zh: 考虑到这是我第二次做这一切，我算是快了一点——也少出了些岔子。

#en: We're gonna be jumping to Eridani III in the Eridani system. Once we're there, we can get things started. You good to go?
zh: 我们要跃迁到波江座星系的波江座III。到了那儿就能开始。你准备好了吗？

#en: We're back to square one, and Watchtower are a big threat again, so we're gonna need more than two ships to keep us safe.
zh: 我们又回到起点，瞭望塔再次成为大威胁，所以我们需要不止两艘船来保命。

#en: Here, Post coordinates for you. Just thinking, if you find more of those slates, I can probably dig up more intel for you.
zh: 给，监听哨坐标。我在想，你要是再找到那种数据板，我大概能给你挖出更多情报。

#en: I know, Gren told me... Hah, he wasn't kidding. Already wiped. But I did manage to snag a location before it nuked itself.
zh: 我知道，格伦说了……哈，他没开玩笑。已经清空了。但我在它自毁前抢到一个位置。

#en: Nothing you couldn't handle, huh? Sounds like famous last words. But, you are still breathing, so... guess you're right!
zh: 「小事而已」，是吧？听着像是经典的遗言。但你还喘着气，所以……算你说得对！

#en: Oh, almost forgot! We've already taken care of the Listening Post, so we can hand those components over to Gren. Go ahead!
zh: 哦，差点忘了！监听哨已经处理了，所以那些部件可以交给格伦。去吧！

#en: These are Watchtower's personal brand of neuroamp. More advanced, more powerful, and more intrusive into the human body...
zh: 这些是瞭望塔自家品牌的神经增幅器。更先进、更强力，对人体也更具侵入性……

#en: However, with some creative workarounds I've devised, I believe it's now possible for anyone to operate a Watchtower ship.
zh: 不过，靠我设计的一些聪明的变通办法，我相信现在任何人都能操作瞭望塔飞船。

#en: I have more control over myself. I can easily focus, even in intense situations. But I still feel things. I'm not a robot.
zh: 我更能掌控自己。即使在紧张情况下也能轻松集中。但我仍有感受。我不是机器人。

#en: As I'm sure you already know, these Watchtower-type mechs are quite powerful. What do you think? Shall I make the attempt?
zh: 想必你已经知道，这类瞭望塔机甲相当强悍。你觉得呢？要我试试吗？

#en: My folks kicked me out when I was fourteen. Guess they figured I was either too much trouble -- or not enough of an asset.
zh: 我十四岁时被家里赶了出来。我猜他们觉得我要么太麻烦——要么不够有用。

#en: I stopped by New Atlantis a few days back. I swear some of the outer settlements had moved around. Why would they do that?
zh: 几天前我去了趟新亚特兰蒂斯城。我发誓有些外围定居点的位置变了。他们干吗要那样？

#en: Plan's unchanged. Locate the facility, neutralize the drones and mechs, grab the Control Node, then head back to Stardock.
zh: 计划不变。找到设施，清除无人机和机甲，夺取控制节点，然后回星坞。

#en: Same plan. Scan the planet for the facility, deal with the drones and mechs, grab the Control Node, then back to Stardock.
zh: 一样的计划。扫描行星找到设施，处理无人机和机甲，夺取控制节点，然后回星坞。

#en: You know, I once heard it said that... "travel broadens the mind". I think we might both agree there's some truth to that.
zh: 你知道，我听说……「旅行开阔心智」。我想我们都同意这话有几分道理。

#en: And the ship they just disabled, has had enough time to get its power back on. Meaning they can't make you go night-night.
zh: 而他们刚瘫痪的那艘船，已经有足够时间恢复供电。也就是说他们没法让你睡过去。

#en: This "Synapse Disruptor", I've seen theoretical papers on similar devices. More powerful alternatives to a common stunner.
zh: 这个「突触干扰器」，我见过类似装置的论文。比普通电击器更强力的替代品。

#en: And they're not aiming to kill you, they're trying to capture you! And believe me, you do not want to be captured by them.
zh: 而且他们不是要杀你，是要抓你！相信我，你绝不想被他们抓住。

#en: That's a good question! I mean, you seem capable, but there's plenty of people like that out there, so that can't be it...
zh: 问得好！我是说，你看起来挺能干，但这样的人多了去了，所以肯定不是这个原因……

#en: And their technology... I-- I don't know if they created it themselves, but what they have is cutting edge, and dangerous!
zh: 还有他们的技术……我——我不知道是不是他们自己造的，但他们手里的东西尖端又危险！

#en: You've done good. Take these credits, please. And if you feel like going after more Arrays, I'd be more than happy to help.
zh: 你干得不错。请收下这些钱。你要是想去端更多阵列，我很乐意帮忙。

#en: The hunt begins anew... Thanks, Harper! If we do go there, we may be able to find more intel for you. If you're interested?
zh: 新一轮搜寻开始了……谢谢，哈珀！我们要是真去那儿，也许能给你找到更多情报。你有兴趣吗？

#en: And you, Torin's Friend? I'd guess you're no fan of Watchtower. If you wanna give 'em a bloody nose, come talk to me later.
zh: 那你呢，托林的朋友？我猜你不是瞭望塔的粉丝。你想给他们点颜色看看，就晚点来找我。

#en: Harper! Before you say anything, I know I bailed on the station, but it was an emergency rescue mission for my friend here.
zh: 哈珀！你先别说，我知道我抛下了空间站，但那是为了救我这位朋友的紧急行动。

#en: I wondered when you might want something new... I've done what I can to prep, and make the process as painless as possible.
zh: 我还在想什么时候你会想要新东西……我已经尽量做好准备，让过程尽量无痛。

#en: Data that would let us upgrade your Fleet Command System, or perhaps even figure out new types of ship modules, or systems.
zh: 能让我们升级你舰队指挥系统的数据，甚至可能弄懂新型飞船模块或系统。

#en: But the biggest headache? Trying to register it. Most records of the station were scrubbed, so officially, it didn't exist.
zh: 但最头疼的是什么？是给它登记。这站的大部分记录都被抹掉了，所以官方上它根本不存在。

#en: If we wanted data on anything outside his wheelhouse, like other types of Watchtower tech, we needed a fresh set of eyes...
zh: 如果我们要他专长之外的数据，比如其他类型的瞭望塔技术，就需要一双新眼睛……

#en: Unless... You wanna take a shortcut? We could always acquire the services of the Advocate. If you've got the Astra to hand.
zh: 除非……你想走个捷径？我们随时能雇辩护者的服务。只要你手头有阿斯特拉。

#en: Those drones were likely left here to keep an eye on things. When we scanned the planet, we must've gotten their attention.
zh: 那些无人机大概是留在这儿看着的。我们扫描行星时，肯定引起了它们的注意。

#en: These "abilities" of yours... I'd be interested in learning more about them! But, that's something we can talk about later.
zh: 你这些「能力」……我很想多了解一些！不过那事我们可以以后再说。

#en: Although, I suppose the occasional pillaging and murder spree may have got their attention. You know, assuming you do that.
zh: 不过，我想偶尔的劫掠和屠杀狂欢可能也引起了他们的注意。当然，前提是你干过那些。

#en: Because where from I'm standing, it didn't go very well at all! But don't worry, I won't rub your nose in it or anything...
zh: 因为在我看来，那走得一点都不顺！不过别担心，我不会拿这个数落你……

#en: Hm. If you want access to that Listening Post, you're gonna have to deal with these guys first... Might I suggest a Skydrop?
zh: 嗯。想去那个监听哨，你得先解决这些人……要不要试试空投？

#en: Despite being augmented and conditioned by them, my loyalty to Watchtower was never strong. To me, it was always just a job.
zh: 尽管被他们改造和调教过，我对瞭望塔的忠诚从来就不强。对我来说，那一直只是一份工作。

#en: They're remarkable, truly! I've never seen technology quite like this before. The crystal substrate they use, fascinating...
zh: 它们真的很了不起！我从未见过这样的技术。它们用的晶体基板，太迷人了……

#en: Based on the data I previously pulled... I have a rough idea on the type of Cyberamps we may be able to extract from a Core.
zh: 根据我之前提取的数据……我大致知道能从核心里提取出哪类赛博增幅。

#en: Utilizes advanced technology to nullify gravity in a localized area, rendering all objects weightless -- for a brief period.
zh: 利用先进技术在局部区域抵消重力，让所有物体短暂失重。

#en: I have good news. I've devised a... method -- that offers an alternative use for ships that you may have defeated in combat.
zh: 好消息。我想出了一个……办法——让你在战斗中击败的飞船有另一种用途。

#en: Spent the next few years scraping by. Petty crime, odd jobs, whatever kept me fed. It was rough. Lost hope more than once...
zh: 接下来几年勉强糊口。小偷小摸、打零工，什么能填饱肚子就干什么。日子很苦。不止一次丧失希望……

#en: Considering you'd need someone skilled in medicine and cybernetics to build 'em, and since Stardock needed a medic anyway...
zh: 考虑到造这些东西需要精通医学和赛博格技术的人，而星坞又正好缺个医生……

#en: Hm... Look, it may be none of my business, but this "vision-giving Artifact" of yours, it may warrant further investigation.
zh: 嗯……听着，也许不关我的事，但你说的那个「带来幻象的神器」，也许值得进一步调查。

#en: Take this, it's got the location on it. If you happen to find more Intel Slates, a good chance I can find more Posts for you.
zh: 拿着，上面有位置。你要是再找到更多情报数据板，我多半能给你找到更多监听哨。

#en: Mobilizes an automated mining unit -- to assist in extracting local resources. Most reliable, even in hazardous environments.
zh: 部署一台自动采矿单位——协助开采当地资源。即使在危险环境中也极为可靠。

#en: On an unrelated note, I now have the capability to copy and fabricate ship modules -- from any salvaged ship you send my way.
zh: 另外说一句，我现在能从你送来的任何打捞飞船上复制和制造飞船模块了。

#en: During my time with Watchtower, I witnessed several branches of government that had been compromised to at least some degree.
zh: 我在瞭望塔期间，目睹了好几个政府部门至少在一定程度上被渗透。

#en: Maybe that's true. But I always suspected that the mental changes, the "dulling" of emotions, also helped to enforce loyalty.
zh: 也许吧。但我一直怀疑，那些心理变化、情绪的「钝化」，也有助于强制忠诚。

#en: Not knowing what else to do, I stuck with Torin, decided to help him however I could. That's how I ended up here at Stardock.
zh: 我不知道还能做什么，就跟着托林，决定尽力帮他。我就这样来到了星坞。

#en: I believe I could construct a Skydrop -- capable of transporting and launching an automated mech -- to assist you planetside.
zh: 我相信我能造出一种空投——能运输并投放自动机甲——在行星表面协助你。

#en: Guess keeping the station active would've stirred up tensions, and Freestar didn't wanna rock the boat so soon after the war.
zh: 大概是维持空间站运转会引发紧张，而星联不想在战后这么快就惹事。

#en: Eh, nothing too crazy. But I've only jumped through the Unity... what, thirty-six times? Still a lot of universes to explore!
zh: 嗯，也不算多。我只不过穿过归一……大概三十六次？还有好多宇宙等着探索呢！

#en: Oh! And the most important thing. If Watchtower gets their hands on someone, chances are, you'll never see that person again.
zh: 哦！还有最重要的一点。要是瞭望塔抓到了谁，你多半再也不会见到那个人。

#en: Although... Should I have told them to take extra precautions...? I've never heard of a detainee needing two neural blasts...
zh: 不过……我是不是该叫他们多加防范……？我从没听说过哪个被押者需要挨两次神经冲击……

#en: We had a dust-up planetside, then raided a Watchtower Array for data. You'll wanna use Gren's algorithm on that Slate there...
zh: 我们在行星表面起了点冲突，然后突袭了一座瞭望塔阵列取数据。你那块数据板该用格伦的算法跑跑……

#en: Torin. I noticed that your ship, and the Skydrop system I spent several weeks retrofitting into it, are suspiciously absent...
zh: 托林。我注意到你的飞船，还有我花了好几周改装进去的空投系统，都不见了踪影……

#en: But not enough to land me anywhere near you post-escape. That's why it took me a while to catch up to you. Sorry about that...
zh: 但不足以让我脱身后落在你附近。所以我花了些时间才追上你。抱歉……

#en: Before that, it laid abandoned for a decade or so. And before that, I think it was some sort of outpost during the Colony War.
zh: 在那之前，它被废弃了十年左右。再往前，我想它在殖民地大战期间是某种前哨站。

#en: Boosts mental focus of primal survival mechanisms. As a result, a pilot is more likely to keep their shield systems maximized.
zh: 提升原始生存机制的精神专注度。结果是，飞行员更倾向于让护盾系统保持满额。

#en: In the end, I gave up. Instead, I registered as a newly constructed station, an orbital ice cream factory. Yeah, you heard me.
zh: 最后我放弃了。转而把它登记为新建空间站——一座轨道冰淇淋厂。对，你没听错。

#en: The thinking behind them was, when you're in the heat of battle, you never know what you might need or when you might need it.
zh: 设计它们的思路是，激战之中你永远不知道需要什么、什么时候需要。

#en: But what if I had arrived sooner? What if I was already there, watching your back? Like I was some kinda... fleet... g-guy...!
zh: 但要是我早点赶到呢？要是我早就在那儿为你殿后呢？就像我是个什么……舰队……家——家伙……！

#en: Never ran across anything like it! Say what you like about Watchtower, but they've got some damn fancy tech at their disposal.
zh: 我从没遇到过这种东西！随便你怎么说瞭望塔，他们手头的技术确实够炫。

#en: All I know is -- is that you'll be minding your own business, then without warning, in jump a whole bunch of Watchtower ships.
zh: 我只知道——你正忙自己的事，毫无预警地，一大群瞭望塔飞船就跃迁进来了。

#en: That's all we needed to do. Guess I'll go board my new ship and then we can be off! That Listening Post won't know what hit it!
zh: 我们要做的就这些。我去登我的新船，然后就能出发了！那监听哨都不知道被什么打了！

#en: From what I recall, Aetherium is mostly funded by the UC. And primarily focused on development of internal cybernetic implants.
zh: 据我回忆，以太赛博主要由联殖资助。主要专注于体内赛博格植入体的开发。

#en: Your station engineer, uh, Gren, is it? He and Harper provided me with the necessary algorithms to break the core's encryption.
zh: 你那位空间站工程师，呃，格伦，是吧？他和哈珀给了我破解核心加密所需的算法。

#en: Mobilizes a Watchtower-engineered combat mech, heavily armed and resilient. Can be salvaged, though recovery is time-intensive.
zh: 部署一台瞭望塔制造的战斗机甲，火力强大且坚固。可以回收，但恢复耗时。

#en: Creates an intense gravitational field, pulling everything nearby to a central point -- and crushing it under immense pressure.
zh: 制造强引力场，把附近一切拉到中心点——并以巨大的压力将其压碎。

#en: Every member of Watchtower I ever met -- seemed to "believe in the cause". Even if very few, if any, knew what "the cause" was.
zh: 我见过的每个瞭望塔成员——似乎都「信仰这一事业」。哪怕极少有人知道「事业」到底是什么。

#en: Infiltrate. Monitor. They have agents everywhere. Even my role as an engineer, had me traveling all across the settled systems.
zh: 渗透。监视。他们到处都有特工。即使是我这样的工程师，也要跑遍整个定居星系。

#en: She agreed! And now we got a medic to treat ailments. Also, she can research and build Watchtower-spec neuroamps! Not bad, huh?
zh: 她答应了！现在我们有了治病的医生。而且她还能研究和制造瞭望塔规格的神经增幅器！不错吧？

#en: Well, lockdown's over and we have the Control Node, we can finally leave this place. C'mon, let's hightail it back to Stardock.
zh: 好，封锁解除了，控制节点也到手了，我们终于能离开这儿了。走吧，赶紧回星坞。

#en: Or, we could always contact the Advocate. If she's in this universe, I'm sure she'd help us! For a price... You have any Astra?
zh: 或者，我们随时能联系辩护者。她要是在这个宇宙，肯定会帮我们！当然要付钱……你有阿斯特拉吗？

#en: Well, then out of the two of us, I suppose that makes you the expert! But a more powerful Disruptor is no longer just theory...
zh: 那在我们两人里，你算是专家了！但更强力的干扰器已经不只是理论了……

#en: Watchtower will still be hunting you, you know? If they find you again, I don't know if I can help you. I mean, I'll try but...
zh: 瞭望塔还会追捕你，你知道吧？要是他们再找到你，我不知道还能不能帮你。我是说，我会尽力，但……

#en: It's fairly simple, really. Maybe you already noticed, but Watchtower's Disruptor, it takes a while to charge between bursts...
zh: 其实很简单。也许你已经注意到了，瞭望塔的干扰器，两发之间要充能一会儿……

#en: An "association", huh? I know what that means. Still, Watchtower would care little for everyday law and order, or lack thereof.
zh: 「关系」，是吧？我懂那是什么意思。不过，瞭望塔可不太在乎日常的治安，或治安的缺失。

#en: But you'll have to give it a little more time before you can actually talk again, and be able to move more than just your head.
zh: 但你得再等一会儿才能重新说话，才能动得比只有脑袋更多。

#en: Never mind trying to piggyback off of someone else's jump! And then, I wasn't even sure I made it to the right universe or not.
zh: 更别提搭别人的跳跃顺风车了！而且我当时都不确定有没有到对的那个宇宙。

#en: It's an inbuilt security measure. It's just how Watchtower tech works! Pretty much all of it has a "self-destruct" of some kind.
zh: 那是内置的安保措施。瞭望塔技术就是这样！几乎所有这些都有某种「自毁」。

#en: Well, anticipating the worst, I had already begun work on building a second Skydrop deployment system. So we now have one spare.
zh: 嗯，因为预想到最坏情况，我已经开始造第二套空投部署系统了。所以我们现在有了一套备用。

#en: ...Mechs? I'm shocked there were any remaining. They were all flagged for transfer... I hope they didn't cause too much trouble.
zh: ……机甲？居然还有剩下的，真让我吃惊。它们都被标记要转移了……希望没造成太大麻烦。

#en: Be advised, Skydrops are used by fleet ships that remain in orbit. If you install a Skydrop to your home ship, it'll be useless.
zh: 特此提醒，空投由留在轨道上的舰队飞船使用。要是把空投装到你的母船上，它会毫无用处。

#en: I can't give specifics, but -- additional vessels, new systems, perhaps even new modules. It'll depend on what data we can mine.
zh: 我说不出具体，但——额外的飞船、新系统，甚至新模块。取决于我们能挖到什么数据。

#en: I can't say I know the full ranking structure. I can only speak to what I experienced... I personally reached the rank of Agent.
zh: 我不能说了解完整的等级体系。只谈我经历过的……我个人升到了特工军衔。

#en: Good luck down there! And remember, when I Grav Shift to escape my ship, I can't guarantee I'll shift back anywhere near to you.
zh: 下面好运！记住，我从飞船重力位移脱身时，不能保证会落回你附近。

#en: Now, if you're flying about all by your lonesome, it's not too difficult for Watchtower to blast you as many times as they need.
zh: 现在，要是你独自飞行，瞭望塔想轰你几次就轰几次，并不难。

#en: Once you can walk again, come find me at these coordinates. I'll do everything I can to keep you safe! You have my word on that.
zh: 等你能走路了，按这些坐标来找我。我会竭尽全力保你安全！我向你保证。

#en: But space is big! As long as you're careful and don't leave a trail, they'll have no clue who pulled the plug or where they went.
zh: 但太空很大！只要你小心、不留痕迹，他们根本不知道是谁下的手、去了哪儿。

#en: However, we still need backup. So, assign a ship to your fleet! We don't want any nasty Watchtower surprises we're not ready for.
zh: 不过，我们仍需要后援。所以，给舰队分配一艘船！我们可不想撞上没准备好的瞭望塔惊喜。

#en: Hah, we have a fleet! Yes, right now it's only two ships... But it's still early days! I'm sure we'll figure out a way to expand.
zh: 哈，我们有舰队了！对，现在只有两艘船……但才刚开始！我肯定我们会想到扩编的办法。

#en: Dr. Sofia Laine, formerly of the Field Surgeons, currently on sabbatical, now presiding over this station's quaint little clinic.
zh: 索菲亚·莱恩医生，前战地医师成员，目前在休假，现主持本空间站这个小巧的诊所。

#en: I'm forwarding the necessary information. From now on, you'll no longer find yourself locked out of Watchtower piloting consoles.
zh: 我把必要信息发给你。从今往后，你不会再被瞭望塔的驾驶控制台拒之门外了。

#en: New shop opened up here, McClarence Outfitters. Heard of it? Some sorta swanky clothing store. Well, as long as they make rent...
zh: 这儿新开了家店，麦克拉伦斯服饰店。听说过吗？某种时髦的服装店。嗯，只要他们交得起租金……

#en: Alright, let's pick up where we left off. Gren and Harper are back on the station. Time to meet them for the first time... again.
zh: 好，我们接着上次的来。格伦和哈珀回站里了。该去第一次见他们了……又一次。

#en: Oh. And we should probably consider taking out Heimdall Station again. You know, stop this universe's Watchtower from bugging us.
zh: 哦。我们大概也该考虑再端掉海姆达尔站。你知道，免得这个宇宙的瞭望塔来烦我们。

#en: From what I've gathered, it seems they've made it their life's work to hunt down and confine individuals they consider dangerous.
zh: 据我了解，他们似乎把追捕并监禁他们认为危险的人当成了毕生事业。

#en: Some credits for your work, you earned 'em. And hey, you wanna smash up more Listening Posts? More than happy to assist with that.
zh: 这些钱是你干活挣的。还有嘿，你想再砸些监听哨吗？我非常乐意帮忙。

#en: And when a vessel gets flagged enough times, an Array sends a signal to Watchtower, telling them to jump a fleet into that system.
zh: 当一艘船被标记足够多次，阵列就会向瞭望塔发信号，让他们把舰队跃迁进那个星系。

#en: As it turns out, corporate labs and bottom-line science didn't sit right with me. So, I walked away and joined the Field Surgeons.
zh: 结果发现，企业实验室和唯利是图的科学让我不舒服。于是我离开，加入了战地医师。

#en: I was just... a normal person. A Cydonia native. Most people raised there end up working the mines, but I didn't want that life...
zh: 我只是个……普通人。塞多尼亚本地人。在那儿长大的人大多进矿场，但我不要那种生活……

#en: Alright, but don't say I didn't warn you! It's not exactly a feel-good story. Before I left Neon, I fell in with a street gang...
zh: 好，但别说我没警告过你！这可不是什么暖心故事。我离开霓虹城前，跟一个街头帮派混在一起……

#en: I think that now he's not with Watchtower, he's just tryin' to figure out his place in the universe. You can't fault him for that!
zh: 我想他既然不在瞭望塔了，就只是在寻找自己在宇宙中的位置。这点你不能怪他！

#en: The mech? Oh yeah, yeah, it's as... it's as dead as dead gets. I checked. Twice... Don't worry! That thing is not getting back up.
zh: 机甲？哦对，对，它……它死得不能再死了。我检查过。两次……别担心！那东西再也起不来了。

#en: Watchtower drones! Damn. They probably detected our scan. We'll have to deal with them before we can head to the planet's surface.
zh: 瞭望塔无人机！该死。它们大概探测到了我们的扫描。得先解决它们才能去行星表面。

#en: Whoa! Hold on, now. That's not quite true. There's more to this, you still need me. Heh. You know, that reminds me of when we--...
zh: 哇！等等。这不完全对。事情没那么简单，你还是需要我。嘿。你知道，这让我想起我们——……

#en: Since then, I've done my best to keep my head down. But it doesn't matter, sooner or later, they always seem to catch up to you...
zh: 从那以后，我尽量低调。但没用，迟早他们总能追上来……

#en: Didn't I already explain that? Hm, maybe not. To be honest, my memory is still kinda fuzzy... But we can go over that later, okay?
zh: 我不是解释过了吗？嗯，也许没有。说实话，我的记忆还有点模糊……不过我们可以晚点再说，好吗？

#en: Hmm... So far, everything I've made has been reverse-engineered from Watchtower hardware. The Fleet Command System, the Skydrops...
zh: 嗯……到目前为止，我做的一切都是从瞭望塔硬件逆向工程来的。舰队指挥系统、空投……
